districts.name: Minecraft and heavy metal
districts.blurb: Leans toward Minecraft, Harley-Davidson, Metallica, Shakira, McDonald's and Joe Rogan, and away from Chanel, Gucci and Patagonia.

districts.name: Pop stars and luxury fashion
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Billie Eilish, Beyoncé, BTS, Gucci, Chanel and Zara, with little interest in Minecraft, Fortnite or Harley-Davidson.

districts.name: Drag Race and Lululemon
districts.blurb: Strongest on Drag Race, Lululemon, SZA, Lana Del Rey, Harley-Davidson and McDonald's.

districts.name: Outdoor gear and Red Bull
districts.blurb: Leans toward Red Bull, Patagonia, The North Face, Nike, Apple and Starbucks, and away from SZA, Drag Race and Friends.

districts.name: Gaming and sports stars
districts.blurb: Heavily over-indexes on Fortnite, Minecraft, LeBron James, Messi, Stranger Things and Joe Rogan, less on Billie Eilish and Uniqlo.
